job.title: Client Partner (Digital)
job.description:
Client Partner
London | Hybrid | Permanent

We’re looking for a senior Client Partner to lead and grow a major global technology account for an established digital consultancy.

This is a senior commercial and relationship-led role, focused on deepening an existing client partnership and expanding the business into new teams, markets and areas of need. There is already a strong relationship and significant delivery activity in place, so the opportunity is less about winning a client from scratch and more about identifying where else the consultancy can add value and converting that into sustainable account growth.

The role
You’ll own senior client relationships and work closely with multidisciplinary internal teams to identify, shape and develop new opportunities.

Typical work sold into the client includes:
  • Digital products, platforms, apps and websites
  • AI-enabled solutions
  • Digital strategy and innovation programmes
  • Early-stage concepts and pilots
  • Customer experience and service challenges
  • Longer-term delivery and specialist team support
Projects can range from shorter strategic engagements through to multi-month delivery programmes and longer-term retained or embedded support.
A major part of the role is growing the account across a complex global organisation: building relationships with new stakeholders, understanding the priorities of different teams and identifying where the consultancy’s capabilities can solve meaningful business problems.

You’ll also take ownership of the commercial health of the account, including pipeline visibility, forecasting, opportunity qualification and early commercial conversations. You’ll be expected to shape initial approaches, team requirements and indicative costs, with specialist teams supporting detailed scoping and delivery.

What we’re looking for
We’re interested in people who have:
  • Led and grown a significant enterprise client within a digital agency, consultancy, innovation business or related environment
  • Successfully expanded an existing relationship into new business units, markets or teams
  • Worked with large, complex global organisations
  • Sold digital, technology, experience, innovation or transformation services
  • Strong senior stakeholder management and relationship-building skills
  • Commercial experience across pipeline, forecasting, costing and account growth
  • The ability to identify opportunities, turn them into credible client conversations and bring the right people together internally
  • Experience working alongside multidisciplinary strategy, creative, technology and delivery teams
The person
This will suit someone ambitious, commercially minded and comfortable operating in a collaborative environment.
You’ll need the resilience and tenacity to keep developing relationships and creating opportunities when progress is not always immediate, while staying focused on delivering strong outcomes for both the client and the business.

Location
Hybrid London role, with regular time in the office. Some international travel will also be required as part of the global client relationship.

job.title: MW Art Director - Freelance
job.description:
Midweight Art Director - Freelance

London | £350-£400 per day | Inside IR35 | 3 days onsite / 2 days WFH

Start date Oct/ Nov - Maternity cover - long contract 3 months with an option to extend to a year. 

My client is looking for a Midweight Art Director with big ideas, great craft and the ability to make things happen.

This is an opportunity to join a brilliant creative team and work across a wide mix of integrated briefs, creating ideas that don't just look good on a page, they actually get made.

You'll be someone who can take a brief, find the interesting bit, and turn it into a strong, scalable creative idea that works across channels.

You might work alongside a Copywriter, collaborate with Designers and Motion Designers, or take a brief away and run with it yourself. Either way, you'll be expected to bring plenty of creative energy, strong art direction and a genuine desire to make the work better.

What you'll be doing
  • Developing big, integrated creative ideas that answer the brief and can flex across different channels.
  • Creating a range of strong concepts to present to Creative Directors and wider teams.
  • Taking ideas from initial scamps through to polished execution.
  • Working closely with Copywriters, Designers, Motion Designers, Planners and Creative Directors.
  • Understanding what makes an idea work across different channels and adapting it accordingly.
  • Bringing strong art direction and visual craft to every project.
  • Presenting and selling your ideas with confidence.
  • Getting involved in everything from big campaigns and pitches to smaller day-to-day briefs — with the same level of enthusiasm.
  • Working with designers and production teams to bring your vision to life.
  • Getting involved in shoots and understanding what it takes to turn an idea into great finished work.
  • Using AI intelligently where it can genuinely improve the creative process.
  • Keeping up with new platforms, technology, creative trends and cultural shifts.
  • Challenging briefs and feedback when you think there's a better creative solution — always constructively.
  • Delivering great work on time, on brief and within budget.
About you

We're looking for an Art Director who is conceptual at heart but knows how to execute.
You'll have:
  • Solid experience as a Midweight Art Director within a reputable creative or advertising agency.
  • A portfolio packed with ideas that have genuinely been made.
  • Strong integrated thinking — you understand how to take an idea beyond a single channel.
  • Excellent art direction and visual craft.
  • The ability to work independently, as well as alongside a Copywriter.
  • Confidence presenting your ideas and explaining the thinking behind them.
  • A commercial understanding of how creative work gets delivered.
  • A collaborative attitude and zero ego — you enjoy working with different disciplines and making the overall work better.
  • Good knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite.
  • An understanding of how AI can be used practically and creatively.
  • A passion for the industry and a curiosity about what's happening next.
The important bit

We're looking for someone who sees a freelance role as more than just the next gig.

Someone who throws themselves into the work, whether it's a huge campaign, a pitch or a small brief that needs cracking. Someone who cares about the detail, wants to make great work and is happy to roll up their sleeves to get there.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to see your book.

job.title: Production Lead / EP - Inhouse content Studio
job.description:
Production Lead / Executive Producer - Europe for a leading inhouse content studio

This will be a 12 month freelance role starting in January 2027
Inside IR35
3 days a week in the office - London
c£500 a day
 
We are looking for an entrepreneurial Production Lead or Executive Producer to establish and lead a modern production capability across Europe for an in-house content studio. 
 
This is a newly created role with a clear mandate: to identify the most effective production solution for every project, balancing quality, speed, creativity and cost.
 
The Production Lead will be the central point of leadership for production, determining the right approach for each project and deciding when work is best delivered through an internal studio, freelance talent, production partners or external suppliers.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and shape the organisation's production capability, operating model and ways of working.
  • Define the most effective production approach for each campaign, content and digital project.
  • Develop and manage a strong network of production partners, freelancers and specialist suppliers across the UK and Europe.
  • Lead productions from initial planning through to final delivery, ensuring high-quality, efficient and commercially effective execution.
  • Manage production budgets, timelines, resources and risks.
  • Partner closely with creative, account and client teams, providing expert guidance on production strategy and delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to improve production processes, efficiency and scalability.
  • Lead, support and develop a Content Producer
  • Scope of work: Work spans always-on social, paid social craft, smaller productions, and larger external productions. Examples include mobilizing videographers, set designers, prop or art departments, animatronics specialists, 3D printers, and other local suppliers for work in markets such as Rome, Porto, Berlin and Spain.
What We're Looking For
  • Extensive experience as a Production Lead or in a comparable senior production role with a Production company background or AND social agency experience 
  • Strong experience across content and social (social first experience ideal)
  • Proven ability to build production frameworks, supplier networks and effective ways of working from the ground up. Supplier and freelancer network across European markets
  • Excellent problem-solving, planning and decision-making skills.
  • An established network of production contacts across the UK and Europe.
  • A strong commercial mindset, with the ability to balance creative ambition, quality, timelines and budget.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment and building new capabilities from the ground up.
  • A collaborative and entrepreneurial approach, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and shape how production is delivered.
What Success Looks Like
  • Establishing a scalable and effective production model across Europe.
  • Building a trusted network of high-quality production partners, freelancers and suppliers.
  • Improving production quality, speed and cost efficiency.
  • Ensuring each project is delivered through the most appropriate and commercially effective production solution.
  • Creating a flexible production model that can adapt to changing project needs and creative ambition.
  • Establishing the organisation as a leader in modern, agile and efficient content production.
We're looking for someone who doesn't simply manage productions, but designs the system behind them — creating a smarter, more flexible and scalable approach to production.

job.title: Partner Marketing Associate (Global)
job.description:
We’re working with a fast-growing, social-first consumer business that has built a huge audience through organic content and is now looking for a Marketing Associate to join its Owned Marketing team.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone early in their career who is genuinely immersed in social, understands what makes content travel and wants much more ownership than you would typically get in a junior marketing role.

You’ll join a small, high-performing team responsible for creating, testing and distributing content across the brand’s own channels. The focus is not simply on making content. It’s about understanding what works, testing ideas quickly and using performance data to help shape bigger marketing and commercial decisions.

What you’ll be doing
  • Build and scale global creator partnerships across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Snapchat, TikTok and emerging platforms, testing performance-based, flat-fee and gifting models to drive content output, views and ROI.
  • Identify viral content formats across platforms and educate creators on how to replicate what works.
  • Develop and scale global creator acquisition pipelines outside of TikTok Shop, while building efficient creator onboarding and education processes.
  • Devise engaging creator campaigns and oversee sampling operations, working with junior assistants to maximise creator participation, motivation, retention and output.
  • Identify and execute affordable creator collaborations, while building and refining outreach, messaging and negotiation processes.
  • Launch and validate new platforms and distribution channels, including Snapchat, Reddit, Pinterest and Amazon affiliates, and rapidly test new approaches to creator-led growth.
  • Monitor partnership profitability and optimise cost efficiency across creator initiatives, using performance data to identify and scale the strongest opportunities.
  • Build repeatable, scalable growth systems rather than relying on a small number of meticulously planned collaborations, while working closely with Paid Social on content usage, rights and creator management.
Who we’re looking for
 This role involves building new systems and strategies from scratch, without a predefined roadmap. You’ll need to be proactive in identifying opportunities, learning from what other brands are doing and developing creative strategies that deliver results.
You’ll be testing, launching, refining and scaling new growth strategies every week. We’re looking for someone who is creative, ambitious and persistent, with a strong eye for opportunities that can be scaled.

Why consider it?
This is a genuinely hands-on role within a business experiencing rapid growth. You’ll have the chance to test ideas, see the commercial impact of your work and learn quickly alongside an entrepreneurial marketing team.
There is significant autonomy, creative freedom and scope to progress as the business continues to grow.

Benefits
  • £30,000–£45,000 depending on experience
  • 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Hybrid working, with four days per week in a central London office and one day from home
  • Pension scheme
  • Regular team lunches, breakfasts and socials
